cells.quote: The reconstruction time showed minimal variability throughout the study period. The median reconstruction time was 26 min (range, 18–34), with an interquartile range of 22–30 min, indicating stable procedural performance from the early phase of the series (Table 2).
cells.note: Retrospective single-center, single-operator series with no comparison group, effect size, or trend test.

O.outcome_detail: anastomotic safety: bile leakage and stricture

cells.quote: Laparoscopic hepaticojejunostomy was successfully completed in all patients without intraoperative conversion. No bile leakage was observed. An anastomotic stricture occurred in 1 patient (4.3%).
cells.note: Retrospective single-arm series; safety rates are reported descriptively without a contemporaneous comparison for the laparoscopic technique.
